cases.name: capability-shape
cases.covers: The capability is workspace-scoped and exists from createKernel(); its members, in the object literal order; the slice holds only disabledCategories.

cases.name: registry
cases.covers: Config commands register in order; register appends and throws on a duplicate or an unparsable shortcut (registering nothing); unregister removes (a missing id is a no-op), and re-registering moves an id to the end; has, ids and menuTarget read the registry.

cases.name: resolve-defaults
cases.covers: With no i18n and no shell, a command resolves to its labelKey verbatim, enabled and visible, not active, with no accent, categories [] and its shortcuts as written; a missing id resolves to null. Surface targets without a shell are inactive.

cases.name: derivations
cases.covers: resolve() calls active, then iconAccent, then enabled, then visible, each with a CommandCtx bound to the explicit document, else the active one (null with none open, and an empty string is kept); their answers land on the resolved command.

cases.name: throwing-derivations-fall-back
cases.covers: A derivation that throws falls back: enabled and visible to true, active to false, iconAccent to none. The command still resolves, and execute still runs it.

cases.name: icon-accent
cases.covers: iconAccent carries what the derivation returns: both colours, one, an empty object; null and undefined mean no accent; a throw means no accent; an absent derivation is never called.

cases.name: categories
cases.covers: config.disabledCategories seeds the slice (copied); a command in a disabled category is disabled and hidden though its derivations still run; disable, enable and set dispatch every time, and the reducer ignores what changes nothing; execute refuses a hidden command.

cases.name: i18n-labels
cases.covers: With i18n present the label is t(labelKey), following the locale; a missing key comes back as the key (and i18n warns once); search matches the translated label.

cases.name: shell-derived-active
cases.covers: Without an active override, a menu command is active while its menu is open, a panel (string or object) or modal command while its surface is open; a menu wins over a panel, a panel over a modal; an empty menu or modal id is no target, an empty panel id is one; an active derivation overrides the shell; the shell is the target document's.

cases.name: execute-routing
cases.covers: Without run, execute routes a surface target through the target document's shell: toggleMenu for a menu, toggle with the panel's exclusive tag (or none), toggle exclusive "modal" for a modal; a menu wins over a panel and a panel over a modal; empty menu and modal ids are no target. Without a shell, or a target, nothing happens.

cases.name: execute-guards-and-run
cases.covers: execute resolves first (every derivation runs), then refuses a disabled or hidden command; otherwise it calls run with a fresh CommandCtx and skips the surface routing. A run that throws throws out of execute; one that rejects or stays pending is not awaited.

cases.name: command-ctx
cases.covers: What a command function can do with its CommandCtx: get resolves a document-scoped token for the target document and throws the kernel's refusal when it cannot; tryGet answers null instead; workspace tokens resolve whatever the target; an empty target falls back to the active document; core() is the kernel's core state.

cases.name: follows-the-active-document
cases.covers: An unaddressed resolve or execute binds to whichever document is active at the call, and to none once the last one closes.

cases.name: search
cases.covers: search trims and lowercases the query, then keeps visible commands, in registry order, whose lowercased label contains it or whose id (not lowercased) does; an empty query keeps every visible command; every command is resolved, hidden ones included.

cases.name: match-stroke
cases.covers: matchStroke returns the first command, in registry order, any of whose shortcuts matches the stroke on the given platform, and null when none does; it ignores enablement.

cases.name: registered-functions
cases.covers: A command registered through the capability carries its functions like a configured one: derivations and run are called with the CommandCtx.

cases.name: re-entrant-registry
cases.covers: A command function may use the commands capability itself: a run that executes another command, and a visible derivation that, mid-search, unregisters a command not yet visited (skipped) and registers a new one (visited, as a Map iteration does); the second time, the registration is a duplicate.

cases.name: after-destroy
cases.covers: A capability reference kept past destroy still reads and changes the registry and matches strokes, but everything that reads the slice throws the TypeError of reading a member of the missing state; category intents dispatch into nothing.
